805114.desc: Spread nightmares of the black empire to up to 5 nearby enemies, horrifying them for 5 seconds and interrupting non-player spellcasting for 3 seconds.

805116.name: Hammer of Twilight
805116.desc: Smash an enemy for 195% Weapon Damage plus 14 Shadow damage, ignoring absorption effects and draining 40 Insanity. Refreshes a charge of Blade of the Empire.

805117.name: Nutcase
805117.desc: Your Shadow of the Void now also increases your critical damage dealt by 10%.

805118.name: Corrupted Soul
805118.desc: Reduces the remaining cooldown of your Eldritch Smite by 2 sec and generates a Void Rune.

805119.name: Corruption - Level 15 Passive
805119.desc: Level 15 Passive Increases spell damage by 20% of your Intellect and your spell haste rating by 10% of your Intellect.

805121.name: Void Strength
805121.desc: Level 40 Passive Increases your Shadow spell damage by 50% of your Strength and your spell hit chance by 5% of your Strength.

805126.name: Shroud of Pride
805126.desc: Your Abyssal Ward now stacks 3 additional times.

805133.name: Entropic Host
805133.desc: A void entity inhabits the ally target, healing them for 1 every 0 sec for 0. At the end of the duration, the entity will jump to another nearby ally. After being affected by Entropic Host 2 times the target cannot benefit from it again.

805135.name: Drained Essence
805135.desc: Entropic Host cannot affect this target.

805169.name: Bend Spell
805169.desc: You will redirect the next harmful spell cast on your master within 3 sec to yourself.

805572.name: Obliteration Beam
805572.desc: Generates 10 Insanity Unleash a beam of eldritch energy, dealing 54 + 65% shadow SP Shadow Damage to an enemy and all enemies within 8 yds of them. While above 60 Insanity, deals 20% more damage.

805576.name: Twisted Mending
805576.desc: Heal a friendly target for 144 to 147.

805577.name: Faceless Slam
805577.desc: Slam an enemy target for 90.2 to 92.2 Physical Damage based on the Cultists Intellect and Spirit.

805578.name: Twilight Shroud
805578.desc: Grant the Cultist a damage absorption shield based on their Intellect for 15 sec. Their next Horrorbolt or Abyssal Reconstruction consumes the shield to deal 100% increased damage or healing.

805607.name: Shadow Training
805607.desc: Level 20 Passive You are now unable to miss your attacks and you cannot be parried or dodged.

805801.name: Wracked Mind
805801.desc: Cannot be affected by Void Shield. Lasts for 15 sec.

806175.name: Dreadfall
806175.desc: Raise your shield and charge towards an enemy, dealing 1 + 200% AP Shadow Damage to enemies you pass through, generating additional threat.

806222.name: Netherstrike
806222.desc: Generates 10 Insanity Strike an enemy quickly for 125% Weapon Damage plus 40 Shadow Damage, purging 1 beneficial magic effect from them. Only usable on enemies below 35% health.

806249.name: Psychic Trauma
806249.desc: Your next Hammer of Twilight or Entropic Slam deals 10% increased damage per stack.

806250.name: Rift
806250.desc: Apply a dark boon to yourself for 15 seconds, causing your next Hammer of Twilight to deal an additional 80% of its damage dealt as Shadow Damage. Creates a rift in front of you that absorbs the next 890 + 150% AP healing taken by enemies that step inside and reduces their periodic healing received by -50% for 10 seconds while inside.

806252.name: Blade of Y'shaarj
806252.desc: Blade of the Empire strikes 2 additional enemies and has a 100% chance to despoil the ground beneath them for 12 sec, reducing the attack power and Shadow resistance of enemies within an 8 yd radius, scaling with Stamina.

806253.name: Blade of N'zoth
806253.desc: Blade of the Empire deals 0% increased damage and it now has a 10% chance to summon a Tentacle of the Old Gods for 8 sec.

806256.name: Twilight Slam
806256.desc: Deals 130 to 133 Physical Damage to nearby enemies and reduces their Spell Power for 5 sec.

806264.name: Power of Yogg-Saron
806264.desc: Level 50 Passive Increases your attack power by an amount equal to your spell critical strike rating.

806266.name: Saronite Mind
806266.desc: Your Eldritch Eye now has 1 additional charge.

806276.name: Befoul
806276.desc: Causes Eldritch Grasp to affect 5 additional enemies.

806382.name: Dark Matter
806382.desc: Channeling Satiate now heals all allies within 30 yds for 208 + 20% healing every 1 sec for 10 seconds.

806383.name: Unblinking Vigil
806383.desc: Applies a shield to the target, Absorbing up to 0 damage. Lasts 10 sec.

806384.name: Visions of the Empire
806384.desc: Increases the damage converted into healing through Abyssal Covenant by 5%.

806766.name: Piercing Entropy
806766.desc: If you are reading this you need to update via the launcher and try to clear your cache.

806768.name: Book of N'Zoth
806768.desc: Your Shadow of the Void now stacks 1 additional time.

806772.name: Book of C'Thun
806772.desc: If you are reading this you need to update via the launcher and try to clear your cache.

807069.name: Abyssal Guard Trigger
807069.desc: If you are reading this you need to update via the launcher and try to clear your cache.

807127.name: Eldritch Smite of Yogg-Saron
807127.desc: Heals nearby allies for 1 and restores 0% of your missing mana.

807303.name: Book of Yogg-Saron
807303.desc: Melee critical strikes grant a stack of Book of Yogg-Saron.

807307.name: Saronite Cube
807307.desc: Melee ability damage now reduces the duration of Wracked Mind by -1 sec on all allies within 30 yds.

807512.name: Whispers of C'Thun
807512.desc: Level 30 Passive Your Gaze of C'Thun now generates 10 Insanity.

807697.name: Heretic - Level 15 Passive
807697.desc: Level 15 Passive Increases your hit rating and expertise by 20% of your Intellect, healing power by 20% of Intellect, and your attack power by 82% of your Intellect.

807725.name: Twilight Domain
807725.desc: You become enveloped with twilight magic, increasing your threat generated by 150%, doubled for Shadow spells and abilities.

808018.name: Dread Crash
808018.desc: Raise your shield and leap towards an enemy, smashing down on them with the unfathomable strength of the Old Gods, dealing 102 Shadow Damage to enemies you pass through. Upon arrival, you crash down dealing 102 Shadow Damage to nearby enemies.

808036.name: Eldritch Shock
808036.desc: Unleashes eldritch power at the target, dealing 340 Shadow damage to an enemy or healing an ally for 375, draining 20 Insanity.

887013.name: CoA Aura - Cultist Class
887013.desc: Tuning aura for Cultist Class. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887062.name: CoA Aura - Cultist - Godblade
887062.desc: Tuning aura for Cultist - Godblade. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887063.name: CoA Aura - Cultist - Corruption
887063.desc: Tuning aura for Cultist - Corruption. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887064.desc: Tuning aura for Cultist - Dreadnought. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

887065.desc: Tuning aura for Cultist - Heretic. Modifies damage dealt, damage taken, and healing done.

1119881.name: Void Resilience
1119881.desc: Gives 30 additional Shadow resistance to all party and raid members within 40 yards. Does not stack with similar effects.
